manuscript_role: CAFRL exactly as specified (the reference run; called A0 in the internal record).

selection.rule: Best-by-validation on the selection metric sel = 0.5 * (video-AUC at c23 + video-AUC at c40), computed on the official FF++ validation split after every epoch; the checkpoint of the epoch with the highest sel is kept. CAFRL arms evaluate the EMA weights, baseline and control arms the raw weights (they train no EMA). No test-split quantity enters selection.
selection.tie_break: Strict improvement (>) — on an exact tie the earlier epoch is kept.

series_notes: `auc_curve.json` reproduces the event file to 5.0e-06 over 50 epochs (redundant; not shipped separately).
`val_loss_curve.json` supplied 3 series that predate the TensorBoard validation-loss tags (val_loss/c23, val_loss/c40, val_loss/mean).

source.note: Host name and process id removed from the event-file name; the sha256 is of the file as it exists in the authors' records.
